```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)
```

# Reading in Data

```{r}
bike <- read_csv("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv", 
                 locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")
)
bike
```

# EDA

## Checking Data

### 1. Missingness

```{r}
colSums(is.na(bike))
```

### 2. Column types and values

```{r}
glimpse(bike)
```

Summary stats for numeric columns

```{r}
bike |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  summary()
```

Unique values for categorical variables:

```{r}
bike |>
  select(where(is.character), -Date) |>
  map(unique)
```

### 3. Convert date

```{r}
bike <- bike |>
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date))
sum(is.na(bike$Date))
```
```{r}
range(bike$Date)
```

### 4. Convert to factors

```{r}
bike <- bike |>
  mutate(across(c(Seasons, Holiday, `Functioning Day`), as.factor))

bike
```

### 5. Rename variables

```{r}
bike_data <- bike |>
  rename(
    date = Date,
    bike_count = `Rented Bike Count`,
    hour = Hour,
    temp = starts_with("Temperature"),
    humidity = `Humidity(%)`,
    wind_speed = `Wind speed (m/s)`,
    visibility = `Visibility (10m)`,
    dew_point_temp = starts_with("Dew point"),
    solar_radiation = `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`,
    rainfall = `Rainfall(mm)`,
    snowfall = `Snowfall (cm)`,
    seasons = Seasons,
    holiday = Holiday,
    functioning_day = `Functioning Day`
  )

names(bike_data)
```

### 6. Summary stats

```{r}
# Function to summarize by given grouping variables
bike_summary <- function(data, ...) {
  data |>
    group_by(...) |>
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      total = sum(bike_count),
      mean = mean(bike_count),
      sd = sd(bike_count),
      min = min(bike_count),
      median = median(bike_count),
      max = max(bike_count),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

bike_data |> bike_summary()
```

```{r}
bike_data |> bike_summary(seasons)
```

```{r}
bike_data |> bike_summary(holiday)
```

```{r}
bike_data |> bike_summary(functioning_day)
```

When functioning_day is zero, the bike rental total is 0 since no bikes are rented if the system isn't functioning. We can drop these to only focus on functioning hours

```{r}
bike_data <- bike_data |>
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes") |>
  select(-functioning_day)

nrow(bike_data)
```
